description: Land Title Settlement Department - Gananikkulama, Nuwaragampalatha East D/S Division, Anuradhapura District - Cad. Map No. 110201 (24/0763)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, extents, and ownership details) by the Commissioner of Land Title Settlement. The content focuses on land ownership, title classification, and property registration, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
